observed_original_abi.receiver_displacement_note: the machine-derived receiver record enumerates exactly {4, 16} (0x4 and 0x10) with bounds_only true, and the listing reaches no other displacement through ECX or through the ESI alias of it
observed_original_abi.seh_frame: PUSH -1 / PUSH 0x012152f8 / PUSH FS:[0] / MOV FS:[0],ESP, restored on all three exits; the state word at entry ESP-0x4 is overwritten with 0 at 0x007c684d
observed_original_abi.return_type_basis: the live decompilation types the function bool and every exit path leaves its value in EAX/AL; this is an INFERRED type, not an observed prototype
observed_original_abi.disputed_derived_claim: the pack's abi envelope claims return_semantics float_or_x87_in_XMM0. The listing refutes that reading: XMM0..XMM3 are loaded from a stack-built four-float vector and passed as an argument at 0x007c6b1d, and no exit path writes XMM0. The disagreement is recorded rather than resolved in either direction.
observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: the live decompilation warns 'Unknown calling convention' and mislabels the stack argument as an unaffected register (unaff_EBX) because the SEH prologue defeats its frame model. The parameter recovery here is derived by hand from the listing: entry ESP+0x4 is the single ordinary argument, it is copied into EBX at 0x007c6769 and re-read from entry ESP+0x4 at 0x007c6abc.

receiver_words.0x4: the object the first indirect call and the two property blocks are made through, and the sink passed to the 0x00841000 log calls
receiver_words.0x10: the container whose first word is the pointer every indirect transfer target is read through

mechanics.argument_reuse: the single stack argument is loaded into EBX and then used as the ECX receiver of 0x00837f30, 0x00838020, 0x00838330 and 0x008380b0, and is printed as a hexadecimal vararg in the per-entry listing line
primary_control_flow: 0x007c6770: 0x00837f30(argument) == 1 selects the current-controller path, which reads the active index through the indirect word at displacement 0x58, indexes the array bounded by the words at 0x94 and 0x98 with a 0x10 stride, and returns the 0x00841000 log result directly
0x007c67de: otherwise the identifier is resolved to a wide string by 0x00838020, whose out-word at entry ESP-0x30 selects between that result and a 'set' property lookup
0x007c681a: isdigit on the low byte of the first word of the resolved string selects the numeric path (0x007c6945) or the name path (0x007c6832)
0x007c6945 numeric: the value is converted through the indirect word at 0xa0 of the receiver word at 0x4 and handed to the word at 0x34 of the container's first word
0x007c6812: a null 'set' result does not reach the epilogue; it jumps to 0x007c6966, the render block, skipping the digit test and both the numeric and the name arm

0x007c6966: when the 'list' property is true the body walks the array and logs one line per entry, re-reading the count at the bottom of every iteration (0x007c6aa4) and continuing while the index is below that fresh value

0x007c6ac0: a 'bg' property read is turned into a four-float frame block by the indirect word at 0xb4, which the body then copies 0xc bytes lower and hands the copy to the renderer's indirect word at 0x58, whose result goes to 0x007c3c20

0x007c6b2c: a 'renderType' property read is converted through the indirect word at 0x9c; the renderer is then called at its indirect word 0x58 with the converted value as the first stack argument and a zero word as the second, and the result goes to 0x007c3ce0

0x007c6832 name: 0x0093c5a0 converts the string into a three-word local, the array is scanned with _wcsicmp, a match activates the entry through the indirect word at 0x54 and the converted name is released through 0x00f47380
0x007c68d4: no match formats 'No such camera' and reaches 0x011e0912, which does not return

indirect_transfers.shape: every one of them loads a word out of an object and calls through the register it loaded; two of the 19 are the import-table slots at 0x013cc4cc and 0x013cc50c, which the xref export names as isdigit and _wcsicmp
indirect_transfers.note: the reconstruction spells each site with the displacement the word was read at and names no dispatch table

mechanics.array_shape: the container's words at 0x94 and 0x98 are the begin and end of an array of 0x10-byte elements; the body computes (end - begin) >> 4 for the count and reads the first word of an element, treating the second word of the same element as an end marker that must differ from the first

string_pool_reads.use: 0x00841000 format for an entry that has a name
0x00841000 format for an entry that has no name
marker for the active entry in the listing line
default trailing vararg when an entry has no described object
last vararg on the no-name listing line: 0x007c6a85 pushes it before the other two, so it is the deepest of the three varargs and the third conversion's argument
prologue only; a compiler artefact, not a call argument
first argument of the non-returning 0x011e0912; 0x014f91b8 is its catchable-type array. Deliberately not named in the candidate, so it is passed as a null placeholder there.

mechanics.frame_slot_aliasing: the frame slot at entry ESP-0x3c is written three times with different meanings: the direct resolve's result at 0x007c67f8, the 'set' property result at 0x007c680c, and the per-entry marker at 0x007c69df or 0x007c69eb. Because all three are the same address, the value the two logging arms read back at 0x007c6a64 and 0x007c6a91 is the marker, not the resolved pointer. That is why the marker, and not the resolved string, is the first vararg of both per-entry format lines.
mechanics.float_buffers: the 'bg' block has two distinct four-float frame buffers, not one: the indirect word at 0xb4 fills the block at entry ESP-0x1c, and the four MOVSS at 0x007c6afa copy it to entry ESP-0x2c, which is the address LEA ECX,[ESP+0x20] hands to the renderer at 0x007c6b19. The candidate now models the two buffers and the copy between them.
mechanics.arg_order_facts: 0x007c6b59 pushes a zero word and 0x007c6b60 pushes the converted value, so the converted value is the renderer's first stack argument and the zero word the second. 0x007c6a3d calls 0x007c65a0 with the type word in ECX and no stack argument at all, so that callee is ECX-argument, not stack-argument. 0x007c68ed and 0x007c68f6 push two words into 0x011e0912 with no ADD ESP after, so that callee pops both.
mechanics.fallback: the resolve path falls back from the direct result to the 'set' property lookup; a null result from that lookup does not end the function, it enters the render block at 0x007c6966 with the direct resolve's pointer still in the frame slot. The numeric arm also ends in that block, by falling through 0x007c6964, so the two arms converge there while the name arm alone can reach the epilogue.
mechanics.pointee_access: every receiver, container and array access is a raw word read; the body performs no store through any pointer it holds
mechanics.reference_operations: none; the body neither retains nor releases anything it is given. The single 0x00f47380 call releases a buffer the body itself produced through 0x0093c5a0, and its result becomes the return value.

frame_derivation.method: ESP was walked by hand from the entry through every push, pop and call in the live listing. Entry ESP is E. The short path ends POP ESI / POP EBX / ADD ESP,0x3c / RET 0x4, which only balances from E-0x3c, and the long path adds PUSH EBP / PUSH EDI at 0x007c67de and unwinds them at 0x007c6b6e, so E-0x3c is the restored short frame and E-0x4c the restored long frame. Every displacement below is quoted against whichever of those two is current at that instruction.
frame_derivation.seh_chain: the three prologue pushes put the scope-table word at E-0xc, and both MOV ECX,[ESP+0x30] (0x007c67cd, ESP=E-0x3c) and MOV ECX,[ESP+0x40] (0x007c6b6a, ESP=E-0x4c) read E-0xc. The two are the same address, which is what makes the frame-slot readings below transferable between the paths.
frame_derivation.argument_slot: MOV EBX,[ESP+0x44] at 0x007c6769 runs at ESP=E-0x40 and reads E+0x4, the single ordinary stack argument. It is reloaded from E+0x4 at 0x007c6abc (MOV EBX,[ESP+0x50] at ESP=E-0x4c) after EBX has been reused as a loop offset, so the long path's property calls still address the original argument.
frame_derivation.dead_zone_write: MOV [ESP+0x48],EDI at 0x007c684d writes E-0x4, which is below the return address and therefore dead stack in a callee-pop frame. The body scribbles there and never reads it back; it is not a saved register and not a parameter.
frame_derivation.out_word_vs_saved_copy: LEA ECX,[ESP+0x24] at 0x007c67e5 runs at ESP=E-0x54 and yields E-0x30, which is exactly what CMP [ESP+0x1c],0x1 at 0x007c67f1 (ESP=E-0x4c) reads, so that is 0x00838020's out-word. The separate MOV [ESP+0x10],EBP at 0x007c67f8 writes E-0x3c, a different slot that only ever serves as the value later read back by the two logging arms.
frame_derivation.why_this_matters: these readings are what fix the null-'set' successor, the marker that both per-entry format lines actually print, the two distinct float buffers, the renderType argument order and the conventions of 0x007c65a0 and 0x011e0912. Each was re-derived from the live listing in this pass and each changed the candidate.

reverification.action: second worker session re-read the 360-instruction body from the live bridge and re-derived the frame arithmetic from scratch rather than trusting the first pass
reverification.listing_read: live GhidraMCP /disassemble_function 0x007c6750, 360 instructions, body 0x007c6750..0x007c6b7c. Not the committed pack, whose disassembly category is a truncated envelope.
corrections_applied: a null 'set' property result jumped to the common epilogue in the first candidate; 0x007c6812 jumps to 0x007c6966, the render block. The list/bg/renderType sequence was also nested inside the numeric arm; it is a separate block that the null-property arm and the numeric arm both reach, and only the name arm can reach the epilogue.

0x007c65a0 was declared __cdecl with a stack parameter while its own comment said the value travels in ECX; 0x007c6a3d pushes nothing, so it is declared __thiscall with the type word as its ECX argument.

0x011e0912 was declared __cdecl with one argument; 0x007c68ed and 0x007c68f6 push two words and no ADD ESP follows, so it is declared callee-popping with the ThrowInfo word carried as a named but unnamed-address placeholder.
the renderer call in the renderType block passed its two stack arguments in the wrong order; 0x007c6b59 pushes the zero word first, so the converted value is the first argument.
the 'bg' block used one four-float array for both the buffer the callee fills and the buffer the renderer is handed; the listing has two, 0xc bytes apart, with a copy between them.

the no-name listing line passed four varargs including the loop index; the body pushes three (marker, wide name, the null word at 0x013ec47c) and then drops six words, so the format's fourth conversion reads a word this body never supplies. The invented index argument is gone.

the per-entry loop cached the element count; 0x007c6aa4 re-reads it at the bottom of every iteration, so the bound is now re-read each time, while the name path's count genuinely is read once and stays cached.
confirmed_unchanged: all 14 string-pool values were re-read from the 3.1.0.22 image at the immediates the body pushes and all 14 match, including the two marker strings and the two null words
the 0x014f9174 ThrowInfo claim was checked by reading its four words (0, 0x00530670, 0, 0x014f91b8) and following 0x014f91b8 to a catchable-type array
all 13 direct callees and the 19 indirect-transfer displacements, the array shape at 0x94/0x98 with its 0x10 stride, the three exits and the RET 0x4 termination all re-derived identically

every hex literal written in the candidate body (21 of them) occurs verbatim in the live listing, and no struct member, data-segment address or dispatch-table vocabulary appears anywhere in the candidate

unresolved_questions: The committed pack's disassembly category is a truncated envelope, so every listing-dependent validation check reads NOT_AVAILABLE for this target. The listing used here came from the live bridge; a reader must not mistake it for the pack's own.
What the 0x0083xxxx property helpers are keyed on is not established: the argument doubles as their receiver, and this body does not show what that object is.

The three-word local at entry ESP-0x1C that 0x0093c5a0 fills is only ever measured (word 2 minus word 0, masked with 0xfffffffe, required to exceed 2). What the three words are, and why the third rather than the second bounds the length, is not established.

The common epilogue returns whatever AL holds on the arriving path. The listing names that value for some paths only, and the reconstruction's false default for the rest is a modelling choice, not an observation.
The identity behind each of the 19 indirect transfers is not established; the reconstruction reports the displacement each target was read at and nothing more.

Which of the two candidate argument shapes 0x00838330/0x008380b0/0x00838020 use as their first stack argument, and whether the recovered strings 'set', 'list', 'bg' and 'renderType' are the complete names, is not established by the body.
Whether the 0x00f47380 result is a success flag or a pointer-width value is not established; it is declared boolean-shaped because only AL is consumed.

The two conflict-ledger entries anchored on this address (app_mode_setter_boundary, camera_address_conflicts) remain unresolved in knowledgegraph/research/conflicts/track-c-state-events.json, and this reconstruction makes no claim about the mode or address transition contract either entry is about.
